page: Amazon Web Services m8i-flex.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server built on the Nitro hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 vCPUs, which correspond to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 32.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates strong single-core capabilities, particularly in text processing where it achieves a top-tier rating. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also perform in the top 25 percent. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations generally fall within the average range. The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, which assist with matrix mathematical operations and vector calculations.

The server offers a balanced resource profile suitable for workloads that require moderate memory and compute resources without the need for local NVMe storage or dedicated graphics acceleration. It is positioned as a cost-efficient option for general-purpose applications, software compilation, text processing, web serving, and moderate database operations.
